instruction: Candid medium shot of four children standing side-by-side in a sunny park. On the left, the boy with glasses (R1) in a yellow t-shirt smiles. Next to him, the girl with curly hair (R3) in a white cardigan and reddish-brown jumpsuit looks slightly to the side. Beside her, the boy with short brown hair (R5) in a blue denim shirt stands looking forward. On the far right, the girl with dark straight hair (R4) in a dark blue cardigan covers her mouth with her hand. They have their arms around each other's shoulders. Warm sunlight filters through the background trees.
elements: R1 is an end child in the shoulder-linked group with shoulder contact to neighboring R3
R3 is between R1 and R5 while the children have arms around each other's shoulders
R4 is the far-end child next to R5 and covers her mouth with her hand
R5 stands shoulder-linked between R3 and R4 while looking forward
the children stand side-by-side with arms around each other's shoulders
